Developer Documentation
***********************

class sim_launch_py.classes.Atom(name: str, index: int = None, atomtype: str = None, resname: str = None, coordinates: list = None, resid: int = None)

   The atom class that stores and manage all the information and
   methods.

   Attributes:

      * name (str) : name of the atom.

      * index (int) : atom index (i.e. referred to its molecule).

      * absindex (int) : atom absolute index (i.e. referred to the
        system).

      * atomtype (str) : atom type.

      * resname (str) : name of the residue the atom is part of.

      * coordinates (list): coordinates of the atom in nm.

      * resid (int) : index of the molecule the atom is part of.

      * element (str) : chemical element of the atom.

      * mw (float) : atomic mass in Da.

      * bonds (list) : list of the index of the atoms in the same
        molecule that the atom is bound to.

   Static Methods:

      * _get_element(atomtype) : Assign atomic element of the atom
        based on its name.

      * _get_mw(element) : Assign mass to the atom based on its atomic
        element.

   static _get_element(atomtype)

      Assign atomic element of the atom based on its name. MW are
      dummy atoms, like those used in TIP4P water.

   static _get_mw(element)

      Assign mass to the atom based on its atomic element.

   property absindex

   property atomtype

   property bonds

   property coordinates

   property element

   property index

   property mw

   property name

   property resid

   property resname

   The group class that manages and stores information about arbitrary

   _check_duplicates()

      Check if there are duplicate atoms in the group and return the
      sorted list of unique atom objects

      Returns:

   property molecules

   property n_atoms

   property n_molecules

class sim_launch_py.classes.Molecule(resname='UNK', index=None)

   The molecule class that stores and manage all the information and
   methods.

   Attributes:

      * name : name of the molecule type

      * resname : residue name

      * index : index of the molecule

      * mw : molecular weight in [Da]

      * atoms : list of atom types of the molecule type

      * contact_matrix : NxN matrix (N=number of atoms in the
        molecule) of the bonds between the atoms.

   Methods:

      * help(): print the help for this class.

   _calc_mass()

      Compute the mass of the molecule and store it in self._mw.

   _compute_contact_matrix()

      Compute the matrix of bonds of the molecule.

   _get_com()

   _renumber_atoms()

      Renumber the atom indexes in the molecule starting from 0.

   _update_atom_resid()

      Renumber the molecular index of the atoms (i.e. the index of the
      molecule they belong to).

   property atoms

   property com

   property contact_matrix

   property index

   property mw

   property resname

class sim_launch_py.classes.Project(name: str, path: str)

   The project class that stores and manage all the information and
   methods.

   Attributes:

   * name : name of the project. This defines the directory where the
     project will be stored and most of path variables.

   * project_path : absolute path of the project. The name of the
     directory is derived from the name of the project.

   * systems_path : directory where the data of the simulated systems
     are stored. This is the parent directory of the systems.

   * topology_path : directory where the topology files (.top and
     .itp) of the molecules used in the project are stored and
     retrieved to be used in each system.

   * init_struct_path : path where initial structures of the molecules
     used in the project are stored and retrieved to be used in each
     system.

   * mdp_path : path where default .mdp input files for gromacs are
     stored.

   * pickle_path : path where the project is saved in .pkl format.

   * job_script_path : path where the template files for submission
     scripts are stored.

   * systems : list of System() objects in the project.

   * molecules : list of Molecule() objects in the project.

   * gromacs : path to gromacs binary.

   * ambertools : path to ambertools binaries directory.

   Methods:

   * help() : print the help for this class.

   * add_system(self,name: str) : add and initialize System() to the
     Project().

   * new_project(name=None, path=None, overwrite=False) : create new
     Project().

   * save(self) : save Project() in Project().pickle_path.

   * load_project(project_folder: str) : load Project() stored in
     project_folde/.multisim.pkl.

   * write_sub_command(self,scriptname: str,hpc_system: str, template:
     str): write job submission/run scripts for the given HPC system
     for each System() and a global bash script to call all the job
     scripts.

   * change_project_path(self,newpath: str) : when implemented, it
     will allow to copy the project to a new path and change all the
     pertinent path attributes.

   _checkAmberTools()

      Look for AmberTools binaries directory and add it to the
      project. This method looks for the antechamber binary. If it is
      not found, it will prompt the user to input manually the
      absolute path of the ambertools binaries directory. The value of
      the attribute is the absolute path of antechamber
      (/path/to/bin/antechamber).

   _checkGromacs()

      Look for Gromacs binary and add it to the project. This method
      looks for standard names of gromacs binaries (i.e. 'gmx' and
      'gmx_mpi'). If either of these is not found, it will prompt the
      user to input manually the absolute path of the gromacs
      executable. The value of the attribute is the absolute path of
      the binary (/path/to/gmx or /path/to/gmx_mpi or
      /path/to/gmx_bin_custom_name).

   _renumber_systems()

      Renumber starting from 0 the index of the systems in a project.

   add_system(name: str)

      Add system to project

      Parameters:
         **name** (*str*) -- system name.

   property ambertools

   change_path(newpath: str, reset_program_paths: bool = False)

      Change path of the project  :param newpath: new position of the
      project. The new position of the project will be
      newpath/Project.name  :type newpath: str :param
      reset_program_paths: Update programs (Gromacs, Ambertools, ...)
      paths? Defaults to False :type reset_program_paths: bool,
      optional

   property defaults_path

   delete_system(delete_list)

      Delete a system from project and update the index of remaining
      systems.

      Parameters:
         **delete_list** -- list of system indexes

   find_system_by_name(name)

   property gromacs

   static help()

   load_project(project_folder: str)

      Load an existing project. The Project object is saved in the
      project directory every time the command Project.save()

      Parameters:
         **project_folder** (*str*) -- Location of the project to be
         loaded.

      Returns project:
         Loaded project.

      Rtype project:
         object

   property name

   new_project(path: str, overwrite=False, check_gmx: bool = True, check_ambertools: bool = True)

      Add new project

      Parameters:
         * **name** (*str*) -- Project Name.

         * **path** (*str*) -- Project path.

         * **overwrite** (*bool**, **optional*) -- Overwrite previous
           project? Defaults to False.

         * **check_gmx** (*bool**, **optional*) -- Check if GROMACS is
           in PATH? Defaults to True.

         * **check_ambertools** (*bool**, **optional*) -- Check if
           AmberTools is in PATH? Defaults to True.

      Returns nproject:
         New project

      Rtype nproject:
         project object.

   property path

   property pickle_path

   save()

      Save project to project folder.

   property systems

   property systems_path

class sim_launch_py.classes.System(name: str, path=None)

   The system class that stores and manage all the information and
   methods.

   Attributes:

   * name : name of the system. This is used to create the directory
     of the system.

   * path : absolute path of the system.

   * molecules : list of Molecule() objects belonging to the system.

   * box : size of the box (of the initial configuration).

   * boxshape : shape of the simulation box.

   * simulations : list of Simulation() objects of the system.

   * run_command : command lines to be used to run the simulations.

   * gromacs : gromacs binary path, inherited from the Project().

   * composition : composition of the system. Order of values is the
     same of the order in self.molecules.

   * atoms : list of Atom() objects in the system.

   * n_atoms : total numer of atoms in the systems.

   Methods:

   * help() : print the help for this class

   * add_molecule(self, name: str, moltype=None, knownmolecules=None)
     : add species to the system.

   * add_box(self, box_side: float, shape='cubic') : create simulation
     box.

   * createSolventBox(self, solvent: object,
     output_structure="solvent_box.pdb", density=None, nmols=None):
     add solvent molecules to the simulation box.

   * insertSolute(self, solute: object, solvent: object,
     solvent_box="solvent_box.pdb", concentration=0,
     output_structure="start.pdb"): add solute molecules to the box
     and remove excess solvent molecules.

   * writeTop(self, atomtypes_path: str, molecules: objects): write
     the topology file for the system in gromacs format.

   * add_simulation(self, simtype: str, mdrun_options='', mdp='',
     print_bash=True, name='',maxwarn=0, start_coord='',gmxbin=''):
     add simulation to the system.

   * print_command(self, bash_file): print the bash script file to run
     the simulations.

   _assign_atoms_to_molecules(atoms: list)

      Add atom objects to molecule objects.

      Parameters:
         * **name** (*str*) -- name of the molecule.

         * **atoms** (*list*) -- list of atom objects.

   static _box_matrix(box: list)

      Given a box vector [a, b, c, alpha, beta, gamma], compute the
      box matrix.

      Parameters:
         **box** (*list*) -- box vector. box vectors (a,b,c) are
         assumed to be i nm, angles (alpha, beta, gamma) are assumed
         to be in degrees.

      Returns M:
         box matrix

      Rtype M:
         list

   _get_box_center()

      _get_box_center _summary_

   _loadfrommol2(mol2file: str, keep_coordinates: bool = True)

      Load molecules from a MOL2 structure file.

      Parameters:
         * **name** (*str*) -- name of the MOL2 structure file.

         * **mol2file** (*str*) -- name of the MOL2 structure file.

         * **keep_coordinates** (*bool**, **optional*) -- keep
           coordinates read from the structure file. Defaults to True.

   static _matrix_to_cell_params(M)

      Convert matrix of row vectors back to cell parameters.

   _renumber_atoms()

      Assign the absolute index to each atom of the system

   static _rotation_matrix(ax, ay, az)

      Build a combined rotation matrix from three Euler angles (in
      radians). Order: first rotate around X, then Y, then Z.

   _update_atom_absolute_indexes()

      Renumber the absolute indexes of the atoms (0-based)

   _update_composition()

      Update the 'nmols' attribute of self.species dictionary by
      checking the residue names of the molecules in the system

   _update_coordinates(structure_file, start=0, end=inf)

      Assign the coordinates of atoms from a PDB structure file.

      Parameters:
         * **structure_file** (*str*) -- PDB file from which
           coordinates are read.

         * **start** (*int**, **optional*) -- index of the first
           molecule of the system for which atomic coordinates are
           updated. Defaults to 0.

         * **end** (*int**, **optional*) -- index of the last molecule
           (included) of the system for which atomic coordinates are
           updated. Defaults to np.inf.

   _update_molecule_indexes()

      Renumber the indexes of the molecules (0-based).

   add_box(box_side: float, shape: str = 'cubic')

      Create simulation box.

      Parameters:
         * **box_side** (*float*) -- side of the box in nm.

         * **shape** (*str**, **optioal*) -- shape of the box.
           Defaults to 'cubic'.

   add_molecule(structure_file: str = None, keep_coordinates: bool = True, keep_box: bool = True)

      Add new molecules to a system starting from a structure file
      (e.g. a PDB file).

      Parameters:
         * **structure_file** (*str**, **optional*) -- name of the
           structure file to be read. Defaults to None.

         * **keep_coordinates** (*bool**, **optional*) -- keep the
           coordinates read from the structure file. Defaults to True.

         * **keep_box** (*bool**, **optional*) -- read the box
           parameters from the structure file and use them to
           define/update the box attribute of the system. Defaults to
           True.

   add_simulation(name: str, simtype: str, simulation_dict: dict = None)

      Add a simulation to the current system object.

      Parameters:
         * **name** (*str*) -- Name of the simulation object

         * **simtype** (*str*) -- Type of simulation. Available types
           are 'em' and 'md'.

         * **simulation_dict** (*dict**, **optional*) -- dict with
           simulation specific parameters. Defaults to None. Values in
           the dict are: 'coordinates', 'mdrun_options', 'topology',
           'path_mdp', 'maxwarn', 'tpr', 'nsteps', 'plumed'.

   add_to_group(name: str, atoms_list: list = None, molecules_list: list = None)

      Add atoms to an existing group.

      Parameters:
         * **name** (*str*) -- Name of the group to which atoms will
           be added.

         * **atoms** (*list**, **optional*) -- List of atoms to add.
           Defaults to None.

         * **molecules** (*list**, **optional*) -- List of molecules
           to add. Defaults to None.

      Returns:
   property ambertools

   property atoms

      Returns the list of atoms in the System.

   property atomtypes

   property box

   center_box()

      Center the atoms in the box with gmx editconf (equivalent to gmx
      editconf -c)

   create_group(name: str, atoms_list: list = None, molecules_list: list = None)

      Create a new group of atoms

      Parameters:
         * **name** (*str*) -- Name of the new group

         * **atoms** (*list**, **optional*) -- list of atoms to add to
           the group. Defaults to None

         * **molecules** (*list**, **optional*) -- list of molecules
           to add to the group (its atoms will be added to the group).
           Defaults to None.

      Returns:
   create_run_script(scriptname: str, simulations: list = None, platform: str = 'bash', platform_dict: dict = None)

      Create the script to run the simulations.

      Parameters:
         * **scriptname** (*str*) -- name of the final script to
           launch the simulations.

         * **simulations** (*list*) -- which simulations need to be
           run. Defaults to None (which means all simulations. I
           know...)

         * **platform** (*str**, **optional*) -- type of platform on
           which simulations will be run. Available are 'bash' for
           running locally, 'myriad' to run on Myriad HPC @ UCL, and
           'archer' to run on Archer2 HPC. Defaults to 'bash'.
           'myriad' is a good starting point for GridEngine-like
           submission scripts, 'archer' is a good starting point for
           SLURM submission scripts.

         * **platform_dict** (*dict**, **optional*) -- dict with
           platform specific parameters. Defaults to None.

   create_topology(topology: str = 'topology.top')

      Create topology for the current system

      Parameters:
         **topology** (*str**, **optional*) -- name of the resulting
         topology file. Defaults to 'topology.top'.

   delete_group(name: str)

      Delete a group from the system

      Parameters:
         **name** (*str*) -- Name of the group to eliminate.

   property gromacs

   insert_molecules(molstruct: str, initial_conf: str, final_conf: str, nmol: int = 1, exact: bool = True)

      Insert molecules in random positions.

      Parameters:
         * **name** (*str*) -- name of the molecule.

         * **molstruct** (*str*) -- structure file of the molecule to
           insert. PN: it supports only structures with a single
           molecule.

         * **initial_conf** (*str**, **optional*) -- structure file
           into which the new molecules are inserted. Defaults to
           None. If no initial configuration is given, an empty box is
           created and populated. System.box need to have been already
           defined.

         * **final_conf** (*str**, **optional*) -- final structure
           file (in PDB format) with the inserted molecules. Defaults
           to inserted.pdb.

         * **nmol** (*int**, **optional*) -- number of molecules to
           insert. Defaults to 1.

   property last_saved_structure

   property molecules

   property name

   property path

   rename_molecules(idx_list: list, new_name_list: list)

      Rename the molecule in the Molecule object

      Parameters:
         **new_name** (*str*) -- New name of the molecule (string of 3
         letters)

   reorder_molecules(order=None)

      Reorder the molecules in the system by Molecule.resname.
      Default behavior (order==None) is to keep the order by
      appearance in the system with the exception of WAT or SOL
      residues  that are assumed to be solvent.

      Parameters:
         **order** (*list**, **optional*) -- Desired order of
         molecules as a list of names, e.g. ['ML1', 'ML2', 'WAT'].
         Defaults to None

   replicate_cell(repl: list)

      Replicate the given box in the 3 directions.

      Parameters:
         **repl** (*list*) -- multipliers for the three directions,
         repl=[1, 1, 1] would mean that the cell is not replicated.

   rotate_cell(angles, degrees=True, recenter=True)

      Rotate the simulation box by arbitrary angles

      Parameters:
         * **angles** (*list*) -- List of angles for the rotation
           (around the 3 axes). Values can be assigned in degrees or
           radians. If radians, select degrees=False.

         * **degrees** (*bool**, **optional*) -- Input angles in
           degrees? Defaults to True

         * **recenter** (*bool**, **optional*) -- Recenter the rotated
           structure in the box? Defaults to True

   save_pdb(pdb_filename: str)

      Save a PDB file with the current configuration of the system.

      Parameters:
         **pdb_filename** (*str*) -- output PDB file.

   property simulations

   solvate(initial_conf: str, final_conf: str, solventbox='spc216.gro', use_gromacs=True)

      Add water to the box using gmx solvate. Choices at the moment
      are:
         'spc216.gro' for 3-point water 'tip4p.gro' for 4-point water

      Args:
         initial_conf (str): name of the input pdb file final_conf
         (str): name of the output pdb file solventbox (str,
         optional): Structure with the solvent box. Defaults to
         'spc216.gro'.

   property species

   property topology

   write_ndx(filename: str = 'index.ndx', overwrite=False)

      Write a GROMACS compatible index (.ndx) file containing the
      groups defined in the system. A [ System ] group will always be
      added with all atoms.

      Parameters:
         * **filename** (*str**, **optional*) -- name of the index
           file, defaults to 'index.ndx'

         * **overwrite** (*bool**, **optional*) -- overwrite existing
           files? Defaults to False

sim_launch_py.external.gaussianFit._histogram(dihedral_angles: str, datacol: int = 1, probcutoff: float = 0.0025)

   Compute the probability distribution given a timeseries of dihedral
   angles

      centers,histo (list,list) : centers of the bins and values of
      the probability distribution.

   Parameters:
      * **dihedral_angles** (*str*) -- text file with the timeseries.
        Angle values are assumed to be in the second column of the
        file.

      * **datacol** (*int**, **optional*) -- column (0-indexed) where
        data is. Defaults to 1.

      * **probcutoff** (*float**, **optional*) -- cutoff value for the
        population of a bin to take into account in the final
        histogram. Defaults to 0.001

   Returns centers:
      centers of the bins of the probability distribution.

   Rtype centers:
      list

   Returns histo:
      values of the histogram of the probability distribution

   Rtype histo:
      list

sim_launch_py.external.gaussianFit._sumGaussFunct(x: list, *parameters: list)

   Sum of Gaussian functions

   Parameters:
      * **x** (*list*) -- x axis values

      * **parameters** (*list*) -- list of parameters of length 3*N
        where N is the number of Gaussians to estimate. Order of the
        parameters is A,mu,sigma.

   Returns f:
      y axis values

   Rtype f:
      list

sim_launch_py.external.gaussianFit.gaussianFit(dihedral_angles: str, datacol: int = 1, plotFit: bool = False)

   Estimate fit parameters

   Parameters:
      * **dihedral_angles** (*str*) -- text file with the values of
        dihedral angles

      * **datacol** (*int**, **optional*) -- column (0-indexed) where
        data is. Defaults to 1.

      * **plotFit** (*bool**, **optional*) -- plot the original
        histogram and the fitted gaussians? Defaults to False.

   Returns centers:
      centers of the fitted distributions

   Rtype centers:
      list

   Returns sigma:
      sigma values of the fitted distributions

   Rtype sigma:
      list
